meta.name: compliance-checker
meta.description: Audits a codebase or business process for regulatory compliance across GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, CCPA, and PCI-DSS. Scans for PII handling, data retention, encryption, access controls, audit logging, consent management, and data transfer issues. Generates a structured compliance report with findings, gap analysis, remediation steps, and evidence requirements.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 审计代码库或业务流程的合规性
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要确保系统符合GDPR、HIPAA等法规
copy.tagline_en: Audit codebase or business process for regulatory compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ensure your system meets GDPR, HIPAA, and other regulations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能审计代码库或业务流程是否符合 GDPR、HIPAA 等法规，扫描个人数据处理、加密、访问控制等七类问题，并生成包含发现、差距分析和修复步骤的结构化合规报告。
howto.when: 当你要求审计代码库或检查合规性时触发，例如说“审计这个代码库”或“检查 GDPR 合规”。

say.text: 审计这个代码库的合规性。
say.note: Claude 会运行完整审计流程，生成合规报告。
Claude 会聚焦 GDPR 框架进行审计。

say.text: 检查加密相关的合规问题。
say.note: Claude 会只扫描加密类别并映射到所有适用框架。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can audit a codebase or business process for compliance with regulations like GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2, CCPA, and PCI-DSS. It scans for PII handling, encryption, access controls, and other issues, then generates a structured report with findings, gap analysis, and remediation steps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to audit a codebase or check compliance, e.g., "Audit this codebase" or "Check GDPR compliance."

say_en.note: Claude runs the full audit and generates a compliance report.
Claude focuses on the GDPR framework.
Claude scans only the encryption category and maps to all applicable frameworks.
